examples.label: Customer Success Associate (rough notes)
examples.brief: Customer Success Associate at +twe, Dubai, hybrid, full-time. You'd onboard university career centres and employers onto the platform, run training calls, answer support tickets and turn feedback into product requests for the product team. Need 1-2 years in a customer-facing role, great written English, comfortable with HubSpot or Intercom. Arabic is a plus. Salary around AED 9,000-11,000 a month. Ideally under 28 and a UAE national.

output.title: Customer Success Associate

company.name: +twe
company.about: +twe is a Gen Z career platform in the UAE connecting students and graduates with employers.

output.description: You'll help university career centres and employers get real value from +twe: onboarding them, running training calls and solving their questions. You'll also be the voice of our customers inside the company, turning their feedback into clear product requests.
responsibilities: Onboard new university career centres and employer accounts
Run training calls and product walkthroughs
Answer and resolve support tickets within agreed response times
Turn customer feedback into clear, prioritised product requests
Track account health and flag accounts at risk

must_have.detail: 1-2 years in support, success, account or similar roles
Clear, friendly English in emails, tickets and guides
Comfortable in HubSpot, Intercom or a similar CRM / helpdesk
Gets to the root of a customer issue and follows it through

soft_skills.detail: Understands what the customer is really trying to do
Takes an account or issue from start to finish

assumptions: Company description written from the +twe name; edit if this role is for a client company.
